title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.


AWS native Architecture

  • Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more.
  • Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized.


Systems Integration

  • Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools.

Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions.


AI Forward Development

  • Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks.

Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform.


Collaboration & Impact

  • Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs.
  • Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning.
  • Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows.


What We Are Looking For

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture.
  • Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation.
  • Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend).
  • Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams.
  • High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work.
  • Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems.


Why Freight Hero

  • Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech.
  • Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes.
  • Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales.
  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives.
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Acquisition Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Acquisition Editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators, and students worldwide use JoVE for their research, teaching, and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including leaders such as Universidad de São Paulo, Universidade Estadual Paulista, Fundação Oswaldo Fiocruz and more. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India, servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We are seeking an ambitious individual to join our team as an Acquisition Editor. In this role, you will focus on recruiting new authors and content for our Journal.


Responsibilities:

  • Identify and recruit new authors, guiding them through the manuscript submission process for JoVE Journal.
  • Contact potential Guest Editors and collaborate with them to build a Methods Collections, our version of a special issue.
  • Establish and maintain a strong network of scientists/journal authors to drive content acquisition and grow submission rates.
  • Collaborate with the peer review team to facilitate the publication of manuscripts.
  • Meet or exceed monthly acquisition targets.


Requirements:

  • A Ph.D. in the Life Sciences.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven, with an ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with the publishing process is a plus.


Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation competitively placed within the local market, including unlimited bonus for manuscript acquisition.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and discovery.
  • Opportunity to work in a remote environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Gerente de People
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de People em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Gerente de People , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia e impacto no negócio:

Definir, evoluir e executar a estratégia de People alinhada aos objetivos da empresa, garantindo que cultura, estrutura organizacional e práticas de gestão sustentem o crescimento do negócio;

  • Escala e eficiência organizacional:

Evoluir e estruturar processos e projetos de People com foco em escalabilidade, padronização e eficiência operacional, garantindo consistência na experiência do colaborador;

  • Parceria com lideranças:

Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) das lideranças, apoiando decisões organizacionais, desenvolvimento de times e estruturação da organização;

  • Liderança da área de People:

Liderar e desenvolver o time de People, garantindo alta performance, clareza de papéis e evolução contínua da equipe;

  • Cultura e engajamento:

Fortalecer a cultura organizacional, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho saudável, com alto nível de engajamento e alinhamento aos valores da empresa;

  • People Analytics e dados:

Definir, acompanhar e evoluir indicadores de People, promovendo tomada de decisão baseada em dados e apoiando lideranças com insights estratégicos;

  • Gestão por métricas e resultados:

Apoiar a implementação e acompanhamento de OKRs, garantindo conexão entre estratégia, execução e resultados;

  • Atração e seleção de talentos:

Definir e evoluir estratégias de atração e seleção alinhadas às necessidades do negócio e à cultura organizacional;

  • People Operations e Departamento Pessoal:

Garantir excelência operacional e conformidade nos processos de Departamento Pessoal (folha, admissões, rescisões, benefícios e obrigações legais);

  • Relações internas e clima organizacional:

Atuar na gestão de clima e relações internas, apoiando na resolução de conflitos e promovendo um ambiente colaborativo;

  • Uso de tecnologia e IA em People:

Identificar e implementar oportunidades de uso de tecnologia e IA para otimizar processos, aumentar produtividade e melhorar a tomada de decisão na área.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia liderando áreas de People em empresas em crescimento;
  • Vivência com múltiplas frentes de People (Business Partner, Cultura, People Ops, Atração & Seleção e Departamento Pessoal);
  • Experiência sólida na estruturação e gestão de projetos e processos de People;
  • Forte experiência com dados, indicadores e People Analytics para tomada de decisão;
  • Conhecimento em OKRs e gestão por métricas;
  • Experiência atuando de forma estratégica com lideranças;
  • Capacidade de liderança, influência e desenvolvimento de times;
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos (startups ou empresas de crescimento acelerado);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de transitar entre níveis estratégicos e operacionais;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de People, dados ou dashboards.


Diferenciais :

  • Experiência escalando estruturas de People já existentes;
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, logística ou ambientes digitais;
  • Experiência com implementação de People Analytics e/ou cultura data-driven;
  • Experiência com uso de IA e automação em processos de People;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Power BI, Lovable ou similares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.


O que oferecemos:

description:

Procuramos uma pessoa Tech Lead de AI para liderar tecnicamente a construção de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, arquiteturas de agentes e sistemas inteligentes aplicados ao produto.

Essa posição terá papel estratégico na evolução da arquitetura de IA da Sankhya, conectando modelos de linguagem, contexto de dados e automação de decisões para resolver problemas reais de negócio em escala.

Buscamos alguém que combine profundidade técnica em GenAI, visão arquitetural e liderança hands-on, atuando próximo ao time, produto e arquitetura para construir plataformas de inteligência que integrem IA ao core das soluções da empresa.

● Apoiar o time na construção de RAGs, agentes autônomos e mecanismos de contexto (MCPs)

● Atuar hands-on em iniciativas técnicas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade

● Mentorar e desenvolver o time técnico, apoiando evolução de carreira e maturidade de engenharia

● Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e arquitetura, apoiando decisões técnicas estratégicas

● Experiência sólida com IA Generativa aplicada a produto

Administrative Support (CRM & Office Operations) – Full-Time

Location: Remote

Schedule: Full - Time

Service Area: Upper Peninsula of Michigan & Northern Wisconsin


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for Okler Roofing which has been serving the Upper Peninsula of Michigan and Northern Wisconsin since 1969. With over 55 years of experience, they specialize in high-quality roofing and exterior solutions built to handle severe weather conditions.

They have been voted Best of the Best in our area for 15 years and were also recognized as Best in the 906, reflecting our commitment to quality, service, and professionalism.



Position Overview

We are hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented team member to support office operations and assist with CRM data entry and organization.

This role is critical to keeping our workflow clean, accurate, and moving forward. You will be responsible for handling incoming calls, gathering detailed information from clients, and ensuring all data is clearly documented and entered correctly from lead through production.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming phone calls and route information appropriately
  • Ask detailed questions and accurately capture client information
  • Enter and organize client data within CRM
  • Maintain accuracy of notes, tags, and job details within the system
  • Create new job files and assign job numbers as leads move into bidding
  • Maintain and update the Accepted Jobs board
  • Set up estimate templates and assist with takeoffs as needed
  • Upload and organize job photos and documents
  • Review CRM entries for accuracy and completeness
  • Send out postcards and follow-up materials to prospective Clients
  • Maintain organization of physical client folders and office files


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong people skills – warm, friendly, and professional
  • Comfortable asking detailed questions and guiding conversations
  • Able to clearly communicate and document information accurately
  • Extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Able to manage repetitive tasks with consistency and accuracy
  • Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment
  • Tech-comfortable and confident using computers daily
  • Experience with Google Drive and Google Sheets
  • Familiar with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Able to quickly learn and adapt to new systems (technology should not be a barrier)
  • Self-motivated and able to stay on task without constant oversight


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Google Drive and Google Sheets
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Suite, including Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • Comfortable using computers and learning new software systems
  • Experience with CRM systems, Knowify preferred but not required
  • Administrative support or office coordination experience
  • Experience in construction, roofing, or home services is a bonus


Why This Role Matters

This position directly impacts how smoothly jobs move through our system. Clear communication with clients and clean, accurate data allow our sales and production teams to operate efficiently.


Compensation

  • Pay based on experience


How to Apply

Submit your resume and a short introduction explaining why you are a good fit for a detail-focused, people-oriented role.

Please include a short paragraph describing your experience with Google Sheets or data entry systems.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

Skills

Preferred Qualifications

Vision & Mission

description:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior III com sólido domínio no ecossistema TOTVS Protheus para atuar em projetos estratégicos de alta complexidade. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver, sustentar e otimizar rotinas complexas utilizando ADVPL e TLPP.

description:

About HCLTech

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

  • Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
  • Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
  • SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

  • Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.
  • Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements:

  • Data Handling: 4-5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
  • SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
  • Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements:

  • Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.
  • Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"\"noisy\"\" data, and propose actionable solutions.
  • Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
  • Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Brazil) (Must align with US PST Time Zone)

  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em Design da Informação e Visualização de Dados, sendo capaz de transformar dados complexos em gráficos, dashboards, mapas e infográficos claros, estratégicos e visualmente atraentes. title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

description:

RED Global, on behalf of a Key Client Partner, is currently searching for a Senior SAP EWM Specialist will be responsible for architecting and implementing high-performance warehouse management solutions on S/4HANA. If you are interested and available, please apply or send an email to for immediate consideration

description:

Tracking Engineer / Digital Analytics Engineer

We are looking for a Tracking Engineer to own end-to-end analytics implementation across a complex, global digital ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, and engineering, ensuring accurate, scalable, and high‑quality measurement across web, mobile, OTT, and emerging platforms.

Key Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager

• Advanced JavaScript skills with the ability to read, understand, and enhance existing code

• Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, vendors, and application development teams

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree preferred (STEM a plus, not required)

• 2+ years of experience in analytics implementation or relevant internship experience

• Strong familiarity with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Tealium, Adobe Launch, or similar tools

• Highly autonomous, self‑starter mindset with excellent time management skills

• Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and creative thinking capabilities

• Demonstrated initiative to stay current with evolving analytics and tracking technologies

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investment Banking Intern em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers, and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

  • Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"\"at-risk\"\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.
  • Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.
  • SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

  • Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.
  • Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements:

  • Data Handling: 4-5 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.
  • SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).
  • Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements:

  • Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.
  • Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"\"noisy\"\" data, and propose actionable solutions.
  • Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
  • Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

  • Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
  • Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
  • Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
  • Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Brazil) (Must align with US PST Time Zone)

Advanced English

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero

FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent.


We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures.


The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs.


About the Role

This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, TypeScript, React, and AWS.

You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices.


What Success Looks Like

A successful engineer in this role:

  • Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems.
  • Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient.
  • Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform.
  • Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities:


Full Stack Engineering

  • Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS.
  • Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices.

description:

Senior Backend Engineer

Hitch — Remote


About Hitch

Hitch is a white-label specialty lending platform powering Non-QM mortgage products (HELOC, DSCR, HEI) and AI-native origination tools for leading non-bank lenders. We sit between borrowers, lenders, and the systems that move money — Encompass, credit bureaus, AVM vendors, pricing engines, payroll, and banking infrastructure.


We treat configuration as a product: one codebase across all clients, dynamic fields, function-based roles. Backend engineers here own real surface area.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build services that power loan origination workflows end-to-end — from soft credit pull through pricing, underwriting automation, disclosure delivery, and offer acceptance.
  • Own integrations with critical third-party systems (Encompass LOS, Plaid, Truework, Clear Capital, MeridianLink, OptimalBlue, Documenso, and more). We treat vendor APIs as a first-class engineering concern — retries, idempotency, outage handling, and webhook reconciliation are part of the job.
  • Architect multi-tenant, configuration-driven systems. Every feature should generalize across white-label clients without forking code.
  • Build and operate background jobs and async pipelines (BullMQ) — webhook processing, credit pulls, document generation, SLA monitoring.
  • Set the standard on code quality, testing, and observability. Mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to architecture reviews.
  • Partner with PM and AI teams on shipping AI-assisted features that require reliable, auditable data infrastructure underneath.


What You Bring

  • 6+ years building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Deep experience with Node.js: async patterns, event loop, performance considerations, runtime behavior.
  • Strong relational or document database design — we use MongoDB with Prisma; you should reason confidently about schema design, indexing, and consistency tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on experience with async/queue-based architectures (BullMQ, SQS, Kafka, or equivalent).
  • A track record of reliable third-party integrations: retry strategies, idempotency, vendor outage handling, webhook reconciliation.
  • Comfort operating in compliance-sensitive environments (SOC 2, lending regulations, audit trails). You don't need to be a TRID expert on day one — but you ask \"what happens if this fails halfway through?\"
  • Strong written communication for async collaboration across time zones (PRs, design docs, Linear tickets).


Nice to Have

  • Experience with tRPC or similar typed API contract patterns.
  • Prior work in mortgage, fintech, lending, or another regulated vertical.
  • Encompass / ICE Mortgage Technology API experience.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or white-label platforms.
  • Familiarity with Next.js (we use it for server-side API layers, not UI development in this role).
  • Working knowledge of Redis, Zod, BullMQ, Prisma.

    • Our Backend Stack

    TypeScript · Node.js · tRPC · Prisma · MongoDB · Redis · BullMQ · Zod · Docker · AWS S3 · Render · Datadog · Jest · GitHub Actions

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Confira esta oportunidade para Cientista de dados em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contratação: PJ (7 meses)

Local: 100% remoto

Horário de trabalho: 8h30 -18h


Necessário inglês avançado (conversação)


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar análise exploratória de dados e preparação de features usando ferramentas e plataformas aprovadas;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e nos testes de modelos de machine learning;
  • Realizar análises avançadas de dados de e-commerce e do site para identificar tendências e direcionadores de performance;
  • Apoiar a interpretação e a comunicação de insights analíticos e achados complexos para stakeholders;
  • Auxiliar na validação de outputs e premissas do modelo em colaboração com times de negócio e técnicos;
  • Documentar os desenvolvimentos e manter documentação técnica relacionada à performance do modelo e às regras de negócio.


Requisitos mínimos:

  • Proficiência em SQL e Python ou R para modelagem estatística e manipulação de dados;
  • Experiência prática com GCP (Google Cloud Platform) e BigQuery para análise de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência com modelos de séries temporais e algoritmos de machine learning (aprendizado supervisionado, não supervisionado, por reforço), trabalhando com diferentes tipos de dados;
  • Forte entendimento de GA4 (Google Analytics 4) e de estruturas de dados de e-commerce;
  • Experiência em desenhar e implementar modelos de dados para otimizar a performance analítica; Forte raciocínio analítico e capacidade de explicar a história por trás dos números para públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Inglês em nível de trabalho para discutir com membros do time técnico fora do Brasil.


Habilidades e experiências desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia trabalhando especificamente com dados de Marketing Digital e segmentação de audiência;
  • Familiaridade com Vertex AI e fluxos de trabalho de desenvolvimento assistido por GenAI;
  • Experiência com modelos de deep learning;
  • Experiência com frameworks de testes automatizados (ex.: pytest) e padrões de validação de qualidade de dados;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes Agile/Scrum e ferramentas de gestão de projetos como Jira e Confluence.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

DevOps Engineer:


We are looking for a full-time, remote DevOps Engineer with 3 to 5 years of work experience to work with our U.S. client. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing highly secure, scalable, and reliable cloud platform solutions on AWS. You will collaborate with the Head of DevOps and other technical leaders to build and maintain infrastructure, automation, monitoring, and security processes. Additionally, you will play a key role in supporting ISO 27001 / ISMS / SOC2 Type II compliance efforts.


This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. While an infrastructure background is beneficial, you should also be comfortable writing scripts and basic software code to enhance and streamline operations.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and the Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with the Head of DevOps to define detailed technical requirements, plan work, and prioritize tasks according to business needs
  • Design, implement, and maintain AWS cloud platform solutions
  • Ensure strict security compliance and best practices in cloud infrastructure
  • Drive automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and system reliability
  • Strive for zero downtime when deploying solutions or services
  • Develop and own scalable processes for: Capacity planning, Configuration management, Monitoring, and observability
  • Provide day-to-day operational support and perform systems administration tasks
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support the platform 24/7
  • Ensure high-quality monitoring coverage for infrastructure and applications
  • Identify potential failure points in infrastructure and proactively develop mitigation strategies
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams for operational support
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type II security frameworks


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills
  • 3 to 5 years of DevOps experience
  • Strong AWS experience in infrastructure, security, and automation
  • Technical infrastructure knowledge across servers, storage, and networks
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Podman, etc.)
  • Experience with SQL
  • Comfortable working in high-security and high-compliance environments
  • Hands-on experience scripting and coding for DevOps automation
  • Experience in database administration, performance tuning, and resilience design
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and best practices
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting for large distributed systems
  • Strong networking fundamentals (IP, traffic flow, network ports, protocols like HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, FTP)
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and drive resolution
  • Experience managing large-scale tasks from inception to completion
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, engineering, or related fields
  • Experience with automation tooling (e.g., HashiCorp products, configuration management tools)
  • Experience with automated testing in DevOps workflows
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), shift-left principles, and immutable infrastructure
  • Experience working in ISO 27001, PCI compliance, or SOC2 Type II environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient:

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Modelagem de dados

Integração de dados (ETL/ELT, APIs)

Identidade e unificação de dados

Preferred

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior AI Software Engineer (.NET + Agentic Workflows) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

QAT Global, a 30+ years IT consulting firm headquartered in the US, is seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Software Engineer with strong .NET and Azure expertise and hands-on experience building AI-powered engineering workflows.

This position will work directly with US-based customers and distributed engineering teams across the US, Brazil, and Costa Rica.


About the Role

This is not a traditional backend development role.

You will help design, build, and operate AI-driven engineering workflows that automate software development activities using modern LLMs and agent frameworks. The role combines backend engineering, AI workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, and critical review of AI-generated code.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across both software engineering and applied AI domains — building automation while also validating and improving generated outputs.

This is an international environment, and the position is collaborative and technically strong.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain AI-assisted development workflows for .NET applications
  • Build integrations between LLMs, internal tooling, and engineering platforms
  • Create and refine prompts, templates, structured outputs, and agent behaviors
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated .NET code and pull requests
  • Develop automation around Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling
  • Build evaluation and verification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to follow enterprise standards and patterns
  • Debug and optimize agent execution flows, tooling integrations, and orchestration logic
  • Contribute to platform reliability, observability, and operational efficiency


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and Entity Framework
  • Strong Azure Cloud experience, including services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Managed Identities, etc.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to read and interpret technical and architectural documentation
  • Hands-on experience working with modern LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, or similar
  • Working proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, or AI workflows
  • Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow design
  • Familiarity with at least one modern AI/agent framework, such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, and similar frameworks
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Advanced English communication skills


Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer tooling or engineering automation
  • AI-assisted code generation or PR automation experience
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Experience with vector databases or RAG architectures
  • Observability or evaluation frameworks for AI systems
  • Experience with Blazor or legacy .NET Framework applications
  • Exposure to prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, or LLM testing strategies


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for engineers who:

  • enjoy solving complex technical problems;
  • are comfortable working with emerging AI technologies;
  • can balance engineering quality with experimentation;
  • have a hands-on mindset;
  • can critically evaluate AI-generated outputs rather than blindly trusting them.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Investment Banking Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

description:

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um Analista de Desenvolvimento Sênior III com sólido domínio no ecossistema TOTVS Protheus para atuar em projetos estratégicos de alta complexidade. Este profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar soluções robustas, garantindo a performance, escalabilidade e integridade do ERP, além de atuar como referência técnica para o time.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de práticas de Code Review e aplicação de padrões de projeto (MVC, Orientação a Objetos).

  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagens : Domínio avançado em ADVPL e TLPP (Ênfase em classes e REST).
  • Arquitetura: Experiência sólida em Orientação a Objetos e integrações REST/SOAP.
  • Ambiente escalável de alta demanda (Jobs/Schedules com multi-thread)
  • Banco de Dados: Conhecimento profundo em SQL Server ou Oracle (Queries, Procedures e Tuning).
  • Gestão de Código: Experiência com ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, GitLab ou Azure DevOps).
  • Testes Unitários / TDD: Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento Front-end com PO-UI (Angular).

  • Conhecimento funcional avançado nos módulos principais (SIGAEST, SIGAPCP, SIGAFIS, SIGAFAT, SIGAFIN, SIGAGPE entre outros).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD aplicadas ao Protheus.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.
