We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.


Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

  • Software: Instalação, atualização e suporte a softwares, com foco em Pacote Office 365 e sistemas legados/ERP (TOTVS).
  • Redes: Diagnóstico e suporte básico de conectividade (rede local, Wi-Fi e VPN).
  • Gestão de Inventário: Organizar e controlar o estoque de ativos (TI), garantindo a integridade dos equipamentos e auxiliando na gestão eficiente de recursos.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação: Ensino Técnico em TI completo ou cursando/graduado em áreas correlatas (Sistemas de Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação).
  • Domínio Técnico:
  • Experiência com ferramentas de chamados (GLPI, Jira).
  • Conhecimento prático em ERP (TOTVS) e ecossistema Microsoft (Windows/Office 365).
  • Vivência em montagem, configuração e manutenção física/lógica de computadores.
  • Noções básicas de redes (TCP/IP, impressoras, DNS).

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de Urgência & Organização: Entender que o tempo do usuário parado é um custo para a empresa; capacidade de priorizar demandas críticas.
  • Olhar de Dono: Zelo pelo patrimônio, cuidado com o estoque e proatividade para sugerir melhorias contínuas.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Excelente escrita e fluência verbal para atendimento ao cliente.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de ouvir, compreender a frustração do usuário e prestar um atendimento humano e prestativo.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).

Sobre a vaga

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Garantir a evolução contínua da arquitetura de TI da Dimensa, atuando de forma transversal nas BUs para padronizar tecnologias, impulsionar inovação e assegurar que os produtos atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, elasticidade, segurança, performance e time-to-market. O arquiteto será responsável por criar frameworks, acelerar a produtividade, viabilizar novos produtos voltados a Dados e IA, apoiar os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura, promover a evolução tecnológica, apoiar a operação de sistemas críticos e representar a arquitetura nas frentes corporativas e junto aos clientes, alinhados à estratégia da arquitetura corporativa.


O Que Você Vai fazer (As Principais Entregas):

  • Apoiar as BUs com diretrizes arquiteturais, garantindo aderência e alinhamento estratégico
  • Atuar na construção e manutenção da nova plataforma de aceleração de sistemas
  • Pesquisar e avaliar novas tecnologias visando à evolução tecnológica dos produtos da empresa.
  • Elaborar e gerir documentos técnicos de decisão, como ADRs, RFCs e RFPs, para formalização de propostas e mudanças arquiteturais
  • Realizar governança técnica com foco em riscos, impactos e sustentabilidade das soluções
  • Propor melhorias e novos produtos com base em oportunidades tecnológicas, dados e IA
  • Representar a Arquitetura em fóruns corporativos e alinhar iniciativas estratégicas com as Business Units (BUs)
  • Definir processos relacionados à arquitetura corporativa e governança técnica
  • Atuar diretamente em crises de produtos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções relacionadas à performance, escalabilidade ou estabilidade
  • Conduzir due diligence técnica de novas soluções, tecnologias, fornecedores e M&A
  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa


O Que Esperamos de Você (Seu DNA de Arquiteto):

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: .NET, Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Cloud & DevOps. Ex: AWS, Azure ou GCP; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions).
  • Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tipo de banco de dados. Ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, além de NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis), etc.
  • Ter capacidade de aprender Observabilidade & Resiliência: Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, Circuit Breakers.
  • Ter capacidade de avaliar Segurança. Ex: OWASP Top 10, OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, gestão de secrets, compliance (LGPD/PCI-DSS).
  • Ter capacidade de utilizar as Metodologias: SCRUM/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, SRE, FinOps básico.
  • Ferramentas de documentação: ADR tools, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io.

Assistência Médica

title: Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client Support and Administrative Assistant, Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position: 

Bilingual Administrative and Client Communication Assistant, Remote 


Job Overview:

We are looking for a Client and Administrative Assistant to join our residential cleaning company based in California, USA. This is a long-term, stable remote position, not a temporary project.

Internal communication is in Portuguese, and client communication is in English. This role is a good fit for someone who is continuing to build their professional experience, communicates clearly and professionally in English, enjoys organization, is detail-oriented, and wants stability in a small, well-organized business. 


Working Hours:

The standard schedule is 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

Optional: up to 2 Saturdays per month.


Two schedule options:


Morning schedule:

Starts at 7:30am Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 11:30 Brazil time. The ideal schedule is 6 hours per day, though the end time can be slightly flexible depending on availability. 


Afternoon schedule:

12pm to 6pm Pacific Time (US), equivalent to 16:00 to 22:00 Brazil time.


Type of contract:

Independent Contractor, Brazilian MEI. 


Requirements

  • Strong English writing skills are required, since most client communication is handled by email and text. You should also feel comfortable speaking with clients by phone when needed. 
  • Basic Spanish for simple communication. You do not need to be fluent. 
  • Comfortable using Google Workspace tools, including Docs, Sheets, and Drive. 
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection, a high-quality headset with voice isolation, and an interruption-free workspace during working hours. 


Responsibilities:

  • Provide customer support through email and text, while communicating with clients clearly and professionally.
  • The role also includes occasional phone calls in English, mainly to handle initial inquiries, ask screening questions, and share service information. This is not a cold-calling or outbound sales position. 
  • Keep client information, appointments, notes, and related records organized.
  • Communicate with the cleaning team in Spanish for basic day-to-day updates. 


Compensation:

  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Gerente de Projetos de Dados/IA - 132722
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Projetos de Dados/IA - 132722 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue como Gerente de Projetos de Dados e IA com foco em ambientes Cloud Azure.

Responsabilidades:

Será responsável pela condução end-to-end do programa de Data & Inteligência Artificial em Azure Cloud, utilizando metodologia Ágil (Scrum), assegurando alinhamento estratégico, entrega contínua de valor ao negócio e conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória. Possui sólida experiência na gestão de programas complexos de tecnologia, liderando múltiplas iniciativas interdependentes de engenharia de dados, analytics avançado, machine learning e IA, em ambientes cloud Azure, com forte atuação em governança ágil e gestão de stakeholders executivos.

  • Liderar o programa de Data & IA sob metodologia Ágil Scrum, garantindo a execução integrada de múltiplos squads;
  • Gerenciar diretamente uma estrutura composta por Scrum Masters e Product Owners, assegurando cadência ágil, alinhamento de prioridades e entrega incremental de valor;
  • Definir e manter a governança do programa ágil, incluindo roadmap, backlog estratégico, gestão de riscos, dependências e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs e OKRs);
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre negócio, tecnologia, cloud, dados, segurança e fornecedores, promovendo alinhamento contínuo entre as partes interessadas;
  • Supervisionar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Engenheiros de MLOps, Arquitetos Azure, DevOps e Analytics, garantindo aderência às boas práticas ágeis;
  • Assegurar o correto uso e integração dos serviços Azure, como Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services e Microsoft Fabric, quando aplicável;
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos de segurança, LGPD, compliance e FinOps na plataforma Azure;
  • Gerenciar orçamento, forecast, margem e relatórios financeiros do programa;
  • Conduzir reportes executivos periódicos, apresentando status, riscos, resultados e benefícios ao nível de diretoria.

Requisitos :

Gestão de Programas Ágeis (Scrum, SAFe, modelo híbrido).

Governança Ágil e escalonamento de Scrum em programas complexos.

Arquitetura de soluções de Data & IA em Azure Cloud.Gestão de Product Backlog, Roadmap e Value Streams.

Governança de dados, segurança da informação e compliance regulatório.

Gestão financeira de programas (budget, forecast e FinOps).

Liderança e coordenação de Scrum Masters e Product Owners.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Infrastructure Engineer Contractor to collaborate with their close-knit and agile Engineering Team. This individual will work with other engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to develop innovative, user-friendly, and high-performance web applications.


You are:

  • Collaborative and experienced working cross-functionally to gather requirements and align with business goals.
  • Comfortable contributing to architecture and design decisions for high-scale systems, with a strong reliability mindset.
  • Highly accountable and dependable, with proven success operating in fast-paced remote environments and maintaining consistent availability.
  • A strong communicator (written and verbal English), able to provide clear updates, realistic estimates, and early escalation of blockers.
  • Detail-oriented and able to write clean, maintainable code and automation scripts.
  • Experienced with ACME protocol (HTTP/DNS challenges), certificate automation, and strong networking fundamentals (TCP/HTTP, DNS, load balancers, WAF).
  • Execution-driven, able to deliver quickly under pressure, and comfortable using modern tooling including AI-assisted development (Claude Code).

You will:

  • Own platform/infrastructure stability through governance, maintenance, remediation, and operational best practices.
  • Build and improve platform services that integrate existing web applications and support scalable infrastructure patterns.
  • Drive automation across deployments, monitoring, alerting, certificate management, and incident response using Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting.
  • Develop prototypes, implement production-ready solutions, and ensure quality through testing.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks, and contribute via architecture/code reviews.
  • Support 24/7 monitoring and incident response (on-call as needed), plus limited IT/SaaS onboarding support on a best-effort basis.


Requirements:

  • 6+ years of professional development experience.
  • Plan, analyze, implement & manage the following aspects of the platform and its associated IT infrastructure.

○ Disaster Recovery Business Continuity (DRBC).

○ Elimination of Single Points of Failure (SPOFs).

○ Implementation of Security procedures, monitors, and awareness organizationally.

○ Automation of monitoring, software deployments via scripting.

○ Instrumentation, monitoring, alerting, and any associated automation and documentation.

  • Tech Stack & Skills:

○ Cloudflare.

○ Azure, AWS.

○ Containers.

○ Kubernetes.

○ Terraform.

○ Linux, Windows.

○ VMs, Reserved Instances.

○ IP Stack, WAF, Load Balancers.

○ Clustering, SQL Databases, NoSQL.

○ Infrastructure-as-Code.

○ Microservices, REST API’s.

○ Ruby, Python, Golang.

  • Must have strong English communication skills (written + verbal).
  • Must have proven experience working remotely with high accountability.
  • Must have consistent working availability with 4+ hours overlap with US time zones .
  • Must be comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude Code) as part of daily workflow.


Even better if you:

  • Extensive experience in Scripting for the purposes of monitoring, deployments, and other associated IT-related tasks.
  • Full CICD methodologies and their associated skills: GIT, GitHub Actions, DevOps, CICD.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing company transforming the restaurant industry through cutting-edge digital ordering solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM


About the role

AI/R Company is a global ecosystem of technology and innovation that brings together companies specialized in digital transformation, software engineering, data, cloud, and artificial intelligence. The group includes well-known companies in the market such as Avenue Code and Compass UOL, working on strategic projects for major organizations worldwide.


With a strong international presence, AI/R Company connects talent and technology to accelerate digital transformation for its clients, fostering a collaborative, multicultural environment focused on continuous innovation.

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead LATAM to lead recruitment strategies for technical positions across different countries in Latin America. This person will be responsible for driving strategic hiring processes, supporting regional leadership in team expansion, and ensuring excellence in both candidate and internal stakeholder experience.


We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in international technical recruiting within IT consulting, strategic mindset, leadership capabilities, and a results-driven approach.

This role will have constant interaction with global stakeholders, technology leaders, and business areas, making strong communication skills, prioritization, and the ability to thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments essential.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead the LATAM Talent Acquisition team, fostering development, performance tracking, and best recruiting practices
  • Drive attraction and selection strategies for technical roles across various seniority levels and technologies
  • Actively manage international recruitment processes across Latin America and/or North America
  • Align hiring strategies with technology leaders, operations, and executive leadership
  • Ensure agility, quality, and predictability in recruitment processes
  • Conduct market mapping and develop sourcing strategies for highly specialized profiles
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and continuously improve funnel performance, SLA, conversion rates, and candidate experience
  • Structure and optimize recruitment processes, policies, and tools
  • Participate in global meetings and collaborate with international teams


Required qualifications

  • Strong experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on technical recruiting
  • Previous experience in IT consulting or outsourcing companies
  • Proven experience leading recruitment teams
  • Strong background in international hiring, especially across LATAM
  • Experience recruiting roles such as Software Engineers, QA, DevOps, Data, Cloud, SAP, among others
  • Advanced or fluent English for interviews and meetings
  • Experience with active sourcing and talent attraction strategies
  • Analytical, organized, and metrics-driven profile


Nice to have

  • Intermediate or advanced Spanish
  • Experience with LATAM operations expansion
  • Experience in multicultural and high-volume environments
  • Knowledge of ATS systems, recruitment metrics, and TA automation
  • Experience working with global clients in the U.S. or Canada



Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and compliance with the most rigorous data protection regulations worldwide, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. Candidates’ data will be kept confidential and used exclusively for recruitment purposes and may be shared with clients and companies within the Compass UOL Group involved in projects.

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

  • Improve engineering processes, delivery predictability, and development workflows across teams

  • Support organizational growth by developing future leaders and strengthening management capabilities
  • Drive alignment and communication across distributed engineering teams operating in multiple time zones

Qualifications:


  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with significant engineering leadership responsibility
  • Proven experience managing managers and overseeing multiple engineering teams in a scaling organization
  • Strong background in Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern software engineering operations
  • Experience scaling distributed engineering organizations in remote or hybrid environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery execution, and organizational health
  • Strong technical foundation with the ability to guide architectural and engineering decisions
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and executive leadership

Hi,

Fractional Account Manager — Partnerships & Growth

Remote Part-Time (Fractional)

Full Time

Why this role exists

Millions of people in the US rely on self-pay healthcare. They face high costs, limited access, and poor transparency.

We are building a membership-based platform that delivers affordable access to care, including primary care, labs, imaging, and prescriptions. Our infrastructure is in place. Growth now depends on strong partner execution and account management.

• Work with channel partners to follow up and close their leads

• Account growth across existing partners

• Higher partner conversion rates

• Strong retention and repeat engagement

• Consistent communication cadence with partners

• Clear reporting on account health and performance

• 1-3 years of experience in account management, partnerships, or healthcare sales

• Experience working with brokers, employers, or channel partners

• Strong relationship management and communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple accounts with clear prioritization

• Experience working remotely with high ownership and discipline

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, early-stage environment

• Mission-driven mindset around improving healthcare access

Strongly preferred

• Experience in healthcare, benefits, or insurance distribution

• Exposure to broker-driven sales models

• Experience in ICHRA or small employer benefits

• Existing relationships with brokers or channel partners
